crossRefs.note: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
“Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation…

translations.web: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
translations.bsb: God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
translations.kjv: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
translations.asv: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,
